title: Disco Inferno
description: A surreal painting featuring a large reflective disco ball suspended in a dark space, surrounded by explosive bursts of golden, blue and brown energy streaks and fragmented dancing figures that appear to be melting or disintegrating into the chaotic scene below.
prompt: Surreal dark scene with a large shiny disco ball hanging from above, surrounded by explosive bursts of golden, bronze and blue energy streaks and fragmented dancing human figures that appear to be breaking apart and melting into the chaotic abstract forms below, dramatic lighting, expressive brushwork, painterly style
